islam.text: And He found you lost and guided you.
So remember Me; I will remember you.
Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.
islam.originalText: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا

islam.text: Whoever saves one life, it is as if he has saved all of mankind.
islam.originalText: مَن قَتَلَ نَفْسًا بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَتَلَ النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا

islam.text: Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.
The best of you are those who are best to their families.
Make things easy, do not make things difficult.

hinduism.text: You have a right to perform your prescribed duties, but you are not entitled to the fruits of your actions.
The soul is never born nor dies at any time.
Set thy heart upon thy work, but never on its reward.
Through selfless service, you will always be fruitful.
Whenever righteousness wanes, I send myself forth.
hinduism.originalText: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत

hinduism.text: The wise grieve neither for the living nor for the dead.
One who sees inaction in action, and action in inaction, is wise.
hinduism.originalText: कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः

sikhism.text: There is but One God. His name is Truth; He is the Creator.
sikhism.originalText: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ

sikhism.text: One who serves the True Guru finds peace.
sikhism.originalText: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ

sikhism.text: The body is the temple of the Lord; within it is the jewel of spiritual wisdom.
sikhism.originalText: ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ

sikhism.text: By His Grace, He blesses us with His Name. With His Name, all hunger is satisfied.
sikhism.originalText: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ

sikhism.text: He who regards all with a single eye and knows them all to be one — he alone is spiritually wise.
sikhism.originalText: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਖਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ

christianity.text: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son.
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.
The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
For I know the plans I have for you, plans to prosper you and not to harm you.
Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast.
Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find.
